scope: skills_kit_lib.audit: the names that left or changed signature when the shipped standards criteria took over the audit checks, and the names that replace them. Other modules are not listed.

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.SkillCriterion
entries.replacement: skills_kit_lib.audit.MechanicalCriterion (the same id and severity record).

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.skill_md_criteria
entries.replacement: skills_kit_lib.audit.mechanical_criteria("skill_md", resolved), which returns the same (criteria, threshold defaults) pair.

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.TYPE_RUNNERS
entries.replacement: audit(): the legacy per-skill-type criteria are shipped in defaults/standards/SKILL-legacy-standards.md and evaluated into the type_specific section.

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.check_reference_skill
entries.replacement: audit(): the ref-* criteria of SKILL-legacy-standards.md.

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.check_pattern_skill
entries.replacement: audit(): the pattern-* criteria of SKILL-legacy-standards.md.

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.check_technique_skill
entries.replacement: audit(): the technique-* and step-tracking criteria of SKILL-legacy-standards.md.

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.check_discipline_skill
entries.replacement: audit(): the discipline-* criteria of SKILL-legacy-standards.md.

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.check_domain_skill
entries.replacement: audit(): the domain-* criteria of SKILL-legacy-standards.md.

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.check_facts_cross_rules
entries.replacement: audit(): the facts-floor, facts-gotcha and facts-example criteria, in the yaml_contract section.

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.check_technique_caution_cross_rule
entries.replacement: audit(): the caution-floor criterion, in the yaml_contract section.

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.check_claude_md_record_floor
entries.replacement: audit_claude_md(): the claude-md-record-floor criterion, in the yaml_contract section.

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.check_claude_md_defaults(body, th)
entries.replacement: check_claude_md_defaults(path, content) for the link and fence rows; audit_claude_md() for the claude-md-import-size and claude-md-size-signal criteria the former four-argument call also returned.

entries.name: skills_kit_lib.audit.THRESHOLDS["import_max_lines"]
entries.replacement: The threshold declared by the shipped claude-md-import-size criterion (resolve_shipped().threshold_defaults).
